game.title: Astral Ascent
game.description:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.  

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE        
 Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. 

 TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE        
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned!  

4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS     
  Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. 
 
• Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

• Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

• Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

• Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases.   

 A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME     
 Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. 

 LOCAL CO-OP        
 The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the  two-player co-op  mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature.

《星界战士》（原名：星座上升）是一款以现代幻想世界为背景的2D平台rogue-lite游戏。作为4个性格迥异的英雄之一，你必须设法从 花园 逃离，这个大花园是一座由12个强大且邪恶的boss守护的星界监狱，另称“十二星宫”。  勇往直前        
 为你的4个不同角色解锁数十个独特的法术。优化你的构建或尝试一个新的方式试图击败12个强大的boss。随着时间的推进你会变得更强，拥有匹配与敌人抗衡的实力。每次跑关都将测试你的技能和反应能力。  好友合作        
 命运的重担想找人一起扛？这个可以有，欢迎邀请好友一起体验我们的 双人合作 模式。通过本地合作或使用    Steam在线远程同乐功能 ，和朋友联手把敌人按在地上摩擦吧！  星体威胁        
 “十二星宫”是由被派往4个华丽世界的12名经验丰富的守护者所看护。他们将在战场上展示独有的攻击，能力和模式，同时揭露战斗背后的故事，让你知道对你展开攻击的原因。接受挑战警告吧！  重玩价值  
 《星座上升》是一款融入叙述的rogue-lite游戏。重玩性是我们故事的一部分，在重复体验中将故事逐步揭开。当你变得更强大，你会发现更多关于角色，动机，以及他们所困世界的秘密。  优美的现代幻想世界  在广阔的风景中穿梭。探索原始和手工制作的领域。通过华丽的艺术和逐帧动画，探索我们的艺术家创造的世界。  4个游戏角色     
  独特的角色。独特的武器。独特的游戏方式。  
    Ayla:  作为其所属刺客公会唯一的幸存者，她能挥舞双刀在敌人做出反应之前就消灭他们。其速度和精巧是无与伦比的。 
    Kiran:  这名孤儿在逆境中体验生活。他可利用自己的力量发动足以产生冲击波的攻击。足够残忍。 
    Calie:  这位才华横溢的雕刻家想要重获自由。她将使用她的魔法宝石刺穿敌人的防御并粉碎他们。冷酷无情。 
    Octave:  在一位强大女巫的训练下，这位年轻的战士能召唤空灵的武器来攻击他的敌人。在需要的时候，他也可以召唤更强大的武器。招招致命。     希望之光：结盟    你可以依靠忠诚的盟友帮你找到出路  
    The Merchant:  这个神秘的人物有能力通过回忆遗忘技能展示你真正的潜能。小心点，这是要付出代价的。 
    Zim-Zim:  她的温室里藏着可以增加你能力的神奇植物。当然，前提是你能忍受她异想天开和不那么成熟的行为。
    Oloon:  全世界最好的造型师就在这里，随时待命。想改变衣服的颜色吗? 想给头发染个新的颜色? 她能满足你一切需求! 
    Papa Yalee:  这只老家伙——快20岁了! - 它能持续分享关于你将遇到的敌人和你跑关的故事。 好消息是……大部分内容都是真实的。 
    Sova:  Sova曾经是一个强大的女巫，后来由于遭受了诅咒，现在她必须服务于这个大花园。她的过去一直是在默默承受耻辱。
    Ordan: 作为花园 实际 的领导者，这位勇猛的战士帮助英雄们完成任务。她拥有传奇的力量。 
    Ikki:  他是Ordan的前夫，也是一名强大的战士，负责英雄们的训练。拥有无尽的兵法知识。

Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.  

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE        
 Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. 

 TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE        
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned!  

4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS     
  Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. 
 
• Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

• Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

• Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

• Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases.   

 A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME     
 Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. 

 LOCAL CO-OP        
 The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the  two-player co-op  mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature.  

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED        
 Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover a fantastic universe loaded with gorgeous art and fluid frame-by-frame animation.

Astral Ascent es un juego roguelite de plataformas en 2D ambientado en un mundo de fantasía moderna. Controlando a uno de 4 protagonistas con personalidades muy marcadas, deberás escapar del Jardín, una prisión astral custodiada por 12 jefes poderosos y sanguinarios: los Zodiacos.  

CREA TU PROPIO ESTILO DE JUEGO        
 Desbloquea decenas de hechizos únicos para tus protagonistas. Optimiza tus configuraciones o prueba otras nuevas para enfrentarte a todos los retos que encontrarás a lo largo de tu camino hacia la libertad. Hazte más fuerte a medida que juegues para estar a la altura de tus rivales. Cada partida pondrá a prueba tu destreza y reflejos.  

DOCE JEFES SUMAMENTE PODEROSOS        
 Los Zodiacos son 12 guardianes expertos que custodian cuatro hermosos mundos. Cada Zodiaco tiene ataques y estilos de combate únicos, una historia y motivos por los que se enfrentan a ti que tendrás que descubrir. Son una amenaza para todo aquel que pretenda escapar del Jardín. ¡Quien avisa, no es traidor!  

CUATRO PERSONAJES JUGABLES     
  Personajes únicos. Armas únicas. Formas de jugar únicas. 
    
• Ayla: una hábil asesina que debe demostrar su valía ante su gremio de asesinos. Con sus dagas elimina a sus enemigos antes de darles tiempo a reaccionar. Su agilidad y destreza no tienen rival.
    
• Kiran: un huérfano que aprendió lo dura que es la vida por las bravas. Con su fuerza bruta lanza ataques tan potentes como para crear ondas expansivas. Brutal.
    
• Calie: una escultora de gran talento que se convirtió en guerrera para recuperar la libertad que perdió su pueblo. Utilizará sus gemas mágicas para penetrar en las defensas enemigas y hacerlas pedazos. Es implacable.
   
• Octave: adiestrado por una poderosa bruja, este joven guerrero invoca armas etéreas con las que puede atacar a sus enemigos: grandes, pequeñas, de corto o largo alcance, pero siempre tiene un arma ideal para cada ocasión. Siempre es letal.    

UNA HISTORIA REVELADA POCO A POCO     
 Astral Ascent es un roguelite repleto de narrativa. La rejugabilidad forma parte de una historia que se irá desvelando poco a poco. A medida que te vayas haciendo más fuerte, profundizarás en la historia de los personajes, sus motivos y los secretos del mundo en el que están atrapados.  

COOPERATIVO LOCAL        
 ¿Piensas que el destino es una carga demasiado pesada? ¡No te preocupes y tráete a un colega para jugar en nuestro modo  cooperativo para dos jugadores ! Luchad y aplastad juntos a vuestros enemigos de forma local o en línea con el sistema Remote Play Together de Steam.  

UN MUNDO DE FANTASÍA EXTENSO Y PINTORESCO A EXPLORAR        
 Recorre paisajes gigantescos. Explora espacios originales y dibujados a mano. Descubre un universo fantástico repleto de ilustraciones magníficas y animaciones de lo más fluidas.

Astral Ascent est un jeu de plate-forme rogue-lite 2D basé sur un univers fantastique moderne et original. Aux commandes d’un des 4 héros et héroïnes aux personnalités et gameplays variés, vous devez vous enfuir du Jardin, une prison astrale gardée par les Zodiaques, 12 boss puissants et vicieux. 

 COMBATTEZ À VOTRE FAÇON        
 Débloquer des douzaines de sorts uniques pour 4 personnages distincts. Optimisez votre build ou essayez de nouvelles combinaisons pour affronter les 12 boss redoutables. Devenez plus fort pour égaliser vos chances contre vos adversaires. Chaque run mettra vos talents et votre réactivité à rude épreuve.  

UNE MENACE ASTRALE        
 Les Zodiaques sont 12 gardiens expérimentés dispersés sur 4 mondes magnifiques. Chacun possède des attaques et des compétences uniques à découvrir lors des combats… mais ils ont aussi leur propre histoire et leur propre raison de vous affronter. Soyez sur vos gardes !  

4 PERSONNAGES JOUABLES     
  Personnages uniques. Armes uniques. Gameplays uniques. 
   
• Ayla : La seule survivante d’une guilde d’assassines, elle utilise ses doubles dagues  pour éliminer en un éclair ses ennemis. Sa vitesse et son habilité sont imbattables.
  
 • Kiran : Cet orphelin a grandi à la dure et ça se voit. Il utilise sa force pure pour infliger de puissants dégâts et les répliques de ses coups blessent les ennemis autour. Brutal.
   
• Calie : Cette sculptrice de génie veut retrouver sa liberté à tout prix. Elle fait tournoyer des gemmes autour d’elle pour annihiler les défenses ennemies et imposer ses idées.
  
• Octave : Entraîné par sa sœur, une sorcière surpuissante, ce jeune combattant invoque auprès de lui des armes éthérées pour attaquer ses ennemis. Si nécessaire, il fait appel à de l’artillerie lourde. Mortel, dans tous les sens du terme.    

UNE HISTOIRE À JOUER… ET À REJOUER     
 Astral Ascent est un rogue-lite imprégné de narration. La rejouabilité fait partie de notre histoire qui se dévoile petit à petit. À mesure que vous devenez plus fort, vous lèverez le voile sur les personnages, leurs motivations, et les nombreux secrets du monde coloré du Jardin.  

JAMAIS SEUL !        
 Le poids de votre destin est trop lourd pour vos épaules ? Pas d’inquiétude : emmenez un ami avec vous dans notre mode coop pour 2 joueurs. Affrontez et anéantissez vos ennemis en coop local ou bien en ligne en utilisant le Remote Play Together de Steam.  

UN MONDE MAGNIFIQUE, MÊLANT FANTASY ET SCIENCE-FICTION        
 Élancez-vous à travers d’immenses paysages à couper le souffle. Explorer des lieux originaux dans une magnifique 2D faite main. Découvrez un monde construit avec précision et amour par nos artistes, depuis le pixel art jusqu’à des cinématiques en dessin traditionnel.

Astral Ascent é um roguelite de plataforma 2D ambientado em um mundo de fantasia moderna. Na pele de 4 Heróis distintos, você deve escapar do Jardim, uma prisão astral guardada por 12 poderosos e cruéis chefes, os Zodíacos.  

CRIE SEU PRÓPRIO ESTILO DE JOGO        
 Desbloqueie dezenas de magias únicas para cada um dos seus personagens. Otimize sua build ou experimente novas estratégias para enfrentar todos os desafios que surgirão no seu caminho em busca pela liberdade. Fortaleça-se progressivamente para bater de frente com os seus inimigos. Cada run testará as suas habilidades e a sua reatividade.  

DOZE PODEROSOS CHEFES PARA ENFRENTAR        
 Os Zodíacos são 12 guardiões experientes espalhados entre 4 mundos deslumbrantes. Cada um com os seus próprios ataques, estilos de combate, histórias para descobrir e razões para lutar contra você, eles serão uma ameaça constante a todos aqueles que desejarem escapar. Esteja preparado! 

 4 PERSONAGENS JOGÁVEIS     
  Personagens únicos. Armas únicas. Maneiras únicas de jogar. 
  
• Ayla: Uma habilidosa assassina enviada em uma missão para provar o seu valor, ela usa suas lâminas gêmeas para eliminar alvos antes que eles possam reagir. Sua velocidade e proficiência são incomparáveis.

• Kiran: Um órfão aprendeu as coisas da vida da maneira mais difícil. Ele usa sua força para desferir ataques poderosos o suficiente para criar ondas de impacto. Brutal.

• Calie:  Uma talentosa escultora que se tornou uma guerreira para reconquistar a liberdade do seu povo. Ela usará seus cristais mágicos para perfurar as defesas inimigas e e transformá-las em pedaços. Ela não perdoa ninguém no seu caminho.

• Octave:  Treinado por uma poderosa bruxa, este jovem lutador conjura armas etéreas para atacar seus inimigos. Seja de grande ou pequeno porte, de curto ou longo alcance, ele possui a arma certa para cada ocasião. Letal em todos os casos.   

UMA HISTÓRIA QUE SE DESDOBRA, UMA PEÇA DE CADA VEZ     
 Astral Ascent é um roguelite repleto de narrativa. A rejogabilidade faz parte da história, que será desvendada peça por peça. Conforme você fica mais forte, mais coisas irá descobrir sobre cada um dos personagens, suas motivações e os segredos do mundo em que estão presos.  

CO-OP LOCAL        
 O peso do destino é muito pesado para carregar sozinho? Não se preocupe e traga um amigo para jogar com você no modo co-op para dois jogadores. Lute e derrote seus inimigos no co-op local ou online usando o recurso Remote Play Together do Steam.

UM VASTO  E COLORIDO MUNDO DE FANTASIA PRONTO PARA SER EXPLORADO        
 Corra por paisagens gigantescas. Explore áreas ricas em detalhes desenhados à mão. Descubra um universo fantástico repleto de uma arte deslumbrante e animações quadro a quadro.

『アストラルアセント』は、ファンタジーな世界を舞台とした２Ｄローグライク・アクションアドベンチャーゲームです。４人のキャラクターから主人公を選び、強大な12体の守護者「ゾディアック」に守られた境界の監獄「ガーデン」を攻略していきます。  意志を貫け  個性的な４人のキャラクターと、数十種類のスペルをアンロックしよう！自分に合ったビルドを見つけ試していこう！そして、どんどん強くなって、ボスへ立ち向かおう！行動一つ一つに、あなたの反応とスキルが試されている。  １人じゃない  宿命を１人で背負うのは重すぎる･･。そんな時は 「２人協力」  モードでフレンドと一緒にプレイしよう！Steamの REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER を使って、ローカル協力プレイや、オンラインで一緒に敵に立ち向かおう！  アストラルの脅威  気を付けて！「ゾディアック」は、華やかな４つのフィールドに位置する強大な12体の守護者です。彼らは、特殊な攻撃、能力、パターンを駆使し、キャラクター達と戦う真の理由を持ってくる！  リプレイ性を通じた物語  『アストラルアセント』は、リプレイ性が高いローグライクゲームです！プレイヤーが成長することで、物語はすこしずつ紐解かれ、キャラクターとその動機や、彼らが閉じ込められている世界の真相を見つけよう！  美しいモダンファンタジーの世界  巨大な風景を駆け抜けよう！繊細な手作り感あるステージを探索しよう！豪華なアート、フレーム単位のアニメーション、アーティストたちが創り出した世界を冒険しよう！  4人のキャラクター     
  個性的なキャラクターと武器、遊び方 
    アイラ：  彼女はアサシンギルドの唯一の生き残り。ツインダガーを使って、気づかれる前に敵を排除する。そのスピードと精度は、他の追随を許さない。
    カイラン：  苦難な生涯を生き抜いた孤児。そこに宿る強靭な心は、衝撃波が出るほどの、強力かつ残忍な攻撃を繰り出す。
    キャリー：  誰よりも自由を求める彫刻家。彼女の攻撃は容赦がなく、魔石を使って敵を貫き、粉砕する。
    オクターヴ：  屈強な魔女に鍛えられた若きファイター。エーテルのような銃を召喚し敵を攻撃する。必要に応じて強大な武器を呼び起こし、すべてに致命傷を負わせる。    希望の同盟   ゴールを目指すうえで、信頼のおける同盟を頼ろう。 
    謎の商人：  この謎の人物は、失われた技術を復旧し、あなたの真の可能性を引き出せる。但し･･それには代償が伴う。
    ヂムヂム：  彼女の温室では、あなたの能力を高める魔法植物が隠されてます。彼女の気まぐれで稚拙な行動に、耐えられるかどうか。
    オルーン：  宇宙一のスタイリストがここにいて、利用できる。服の色を変えたい？髪を染めたい？必要なものは何でもそろってる！
    パパ・ヤリー：  もうすぐ20歳になるこの老猫は、あなたが遭遇するであろう敵や、あなたが走る先について、いつも良い話をするだろう。
    ソヴァ：  かつて強力な魔術師だった彼女は呪われてしまい、今はガーデンに仕えなければならなかった。彼女は過去を「恥」思い、沈黙を続けている。
    オルダン：   ガーデンの実質リーダー  であり、この勇敢な戦士は、英雄探しを助けている。彼女の力は伝説となっている。
    イッキ：  オルダンの元夫であり、強力な戦士の一人である彼は、英雄たちの育成を担当している。彼の戦争術の知識は尽きない。

game.brief:
Astral Ascent is a 2D platformer roguelite game set in a modern fantasy world. As one of 4 Heroes with very different personalities, you must escape from The Garden, an astral prison guarded by 12 powerful and vicious bosses, the Zodiacs.  

CREATE YOUR OWN PLAYSTYLE        
 Unlock dozens of unique spells for each or your characters. Optimize your own build or try out new ones to face all the challenges you'll find on your journey for freedom. Get progressively stronger with time to match up with your foes. Each run will test your skills and your reactivity. 

 TWELVE ALMIGHTY BOSSES TO FACE        
The Zodiacs are 12 experienced guardians dispatched over 4 gorgeous worlds. Each with their own unique attacks and combat styles, backstories to uncover and reasons to be fighting you, they'll pose as a big threat to anyone seeking a way out of the Garden . Get yourself warned!  

4 PLAYABLE CHARACTERS     
  Unique characters. Unique weapons. Unique ways to play. 
 
• Ayla: A skilled assassin sent on a mission by her guild to prove her worth, she uses her sharp blades to eliminate targets before they can react. Her speed and proficiency are unmatched.

• Kiran: An orphan that has learned life the hard way. He uses his raw strength to deliver attacks powerful enough to create shockwaves. Brutal.

• Calie: This talented sculptor became a warrior to recover the freedom her people have lost. She will use her magical gemstones to pierce enemy defenses and shred them to bits. She is unforgiving.

• Octave: Trained by a powerful witch, this young fighter summons ethereal weapons to attack his foes. Big or small, short or long range, he has the right one for every occasion. Lethal in all cases.   

 A STORY THAT OPENS UP, ONE PIECE AT A TIME     
 Astral Ascent is a roguelite infused with narration. Replayability is part of a story that will be unraveled piece by piece. As you get stronger, you will discover more about the characters, their motivations and the secrets of the world they’re trapped in. 

 LOCAL CO-OP        
 The weight of destiny is too heavy to carry by yourself? Don’t worry and bring a friend to play with the  two-player co-op  mode. Fight and crush your enemies together in local co-op or online using the Steam's Remote Play Together feature.  

A VAST, COLORFUL FANTASY WORLD WAITING TO BE EXPLORED        
 Dash across gigantic landscapes. Explore original and hand-crafted areas. Discover a fantastic universe loaded with gorgeous art and fluid frame-by-frame animation.

game.title: LEGO The Hobbit
game.description:
Reclaim the Lost Kingdom brick by brick! Join Bilbo Baggins, Gandalf, Thorin and his company of Dwarves in an epic adventure across Middle-earth to recapture the Lonely Mountain in the most expansive LEGO game to date.  

• Battle ravenous Trolls, dangerous Orcs and many more!
 
• Combine the Dwarves' unique abilities to solve puzzles — often with hilarious results!
 
• Explore iconic locations in Middle-earth, from the Shire to Goblin-town and beyond.

  • Explora lugares icónicos da Terra Média como o Shire, a cidade dos Goblins e muito mais.

Genvind det tabte kongerige en klods ad gangen! Slut dig til Bilbo Sækker, Gandalf, Thorin Egeskjold og hans kompagni af dværge i et episk eventyr på tværs af Midgård for at genindtage Det ensomme Bjerg i det mest ekspansive LEGO spil til dato.

  • Kombinér dværgenes unikke evner for at løse gåder – ofte med morsomme udfald!

  • Udforsk ikoniske steder i Midgård fra Herredet til Bjergtroldeby og hinsides.

game.title: Tiny Bunny
game.description:
Tiny Bunny Is A Non-linear Horror Visual Novel.  When winter comes, everything falls into slumber — everything except this forest.

  There's something wandering its snow-covered paths, lurking behind black trees, and taking whatever it considers due.
  
  It leaves behind strange rumors: voices calling you into the thicket, faces watching through your windows, mysterious prints in the snow, and… a growing number of missing-child posters.
  
  Those who have heard the voice of the forest are beyond help. Their only option is to sink deeper and deeper into its cold embrace and face their final choice in that icy darkness: to stay alive… or to stay human?
  
  Tiny Bunny is a non-linear horror visual novel with a branching plot, inspired by the short story of the same name by Dmitry Mordas. You’ll play as Anton, a young boy who has recently moved to a small, remote town surrounded by forest. In this isolated place, you find yourself pulled into a deepening mystery as unsettling events occur and local children begin to go missing. Your choices determine which paths open up as the danger around the town escalates.
  
  ✔ A fascinating horror story that lingers long after the screen goes dark
  ✔ Your choices carry weight, making every moment tense and unforgettable
  ✔ Hand-drawn, black-and-white art style 
  ✔ Bone-piercing original soundtrack
  ✔ Featuring 20 distinct endings
  ✔ Disturbing, oppressive atmosphere
  ✔ Horrifying secrets
  
  Warning! This game contains offensive language and scenes of physical and psychological violence. Proceed with caution!

《 小兔子 》是一款非线性恐怖视觉小说。听到森林之声的人不会得救。
  游戏共有5个章节，第1和第2个章节已经上架了steam，希望您能玩得开心。
  
  冬天来了，万物都在沉睡，只有森林还醒着。
  有某个东西在白雪皑皑的林间小径上徘徊。它就躲在黑色的枯树后，伺机夺走属于它的一切。
  它在出没之地留下了奇怪的传闻：有神秘的声音唆使你走进森林的灌木丛，有神秘的存在会从窗户外面仅仅盯着你，有神秘的脚印会出现在雪地上……
  还有真实存在的，那一张又一张的“失踪儿童”告示。
  听到森林之声的人已经无药可救。
  他们只能在恐怖寒冷的怀抱中越陷越深，于冷冰冰的黑暗中面对自己最后的抉择：
  是要活下去，还是坚守人性？
  
  
  《Tiny Bunny》是一款恐怖类型的非线性视觉小说，改编自德米特里•莫达斯的同名短篇小说。
  故事发生在西伯利亚森林中一个安静、平凡的村庄里。主人公安东刚刚跟着家人搬到了这里，但随即就目击到了不寻常的东西，被迫卷入了一系列令人不安的事件。
  当地的孩子一个接一个的失踪。面对这一系列失踪案件，警察也无能为力。他们虽然派了森林搜救队，但还是找不到失踪儿童的半点踪迹。
  然而，安东却不断发现神秘的指纹、血迹和衣服碎片，简直就像是有人故意拿给他看的一样。这一切到底是怎么回事？
  安东起初只是被噩梦困扰，可随着时间的推移，他每天晚上的噩梦变得越来越可怕，越来越血腥，越来越真实，也越来越……诱人。
  
  
  我们打算一共发布5个章节，第1、第2章现已发售。[/b] 。
  
  ✔引人入胜、难以忘怀的恐怖故事。
  ✔你的每一个选择都会影响故事的走向。
  ✔黑白风格的精致CG，营造出独特的恐怖氛围。
  ✔原创OST，每一首都能让你感受到渗入骨髓的恐怖与寒意。
  ✔不安又压抑的游戏氛围。
  ✔游戏剧情中藏有许多令人震惊的秘密，保证能让你在揭晓的那一刻头皮发麻。
  
  
  “游戏预警！本游戏含有粗口和精神、肢体暴力的画面，请多加注意！”

あらゆるものが眠りにつく冬が来ても、この森は眠らない。
  何かが雪道を彷徨い、黒い木々の陰に潜み、然るべきものを奪っていく。
  あとには奇妙な噂が残る。茂みの中へ誘う声、窓の中を覗き込む顔、雪に残された不思議な足跡、そして…行方不明の子供たちのポスター。
  森の声が聞こえたら、もう助からない。冷たい恐怖に抱かれ、凍えるような暗闇の中で最後の選択をするしかない。選ぶべきは生存か、人間性か？
  『Tiny Bunny』は、ドミートリー・モルダースによる同名の短編小説をもとにした、ストーリー分岐のあるホラービジュアルノベルです。舞台はシベリアの森の中にひっそりとたたずむ村。そこで子供たちが行方不明になり始め、小学6年生の主人公は、家族とともに引っ越してきたばかりだというのに、一連の不気味な出来事を目撃して、関わらざるを得なくなります。
  本作は全5章を予定しています。現在は第4章まで収録され、プレイ可能です。ぜひ体験してみてください。
  ✔ 脳裏に焼き付く印象深いホラーストーリー
  ✔ プレイヤーの選択によって分岐するシナリオ
  ✔ スタイリッシュな白黒のグラフィック
  ✔ 全身に恐怖が染み渡るオリジナル・サウンドトラック
  ✔ 不穏で重苦しい演出
  ✔ おぞましい秘密
  コンテンツに関する警告：このゲームには不快な言葉遣いや身体的・心理的暴力描写が含まれます。苦手な方は十分に注意してプレイしてください。

《小兔子》是一款恐怖类型的非线性视觉小说。

随着冬天的到来，一切都睡着了，只有这片森林还在醒着。
某个东西游荡在林间雪路边、躲在黑树木后、取回属于它的一切。
它只留下奇怪的谣言：从密林里传来的声音，朝窗里望去的面目，雪地上的莫名其妙的脚印……还有失踪儿童的报告。
听到森林之声的人不会得救。
那个人投入到恐怖冷冷的怀抱中后，只能在冰冷的黑暗里做出最后的选择：保持生命还是保持人道？

game.title: House Flipper
game.description: House Flipper is a unique chance to become the one-man renovating crew. You've got to earn it around here before you purchase your first property. No worries though! Luckily, there's plenty of work at your fingertips! Take job offers from nearby residents to clean up, paint walls, install heaters, showers, and air conditioners, or even furnish their whole property! Once the grateful clients pay you for your solid work, it's time to get your own house.

localized_description.text: 《房产达人》是个能让你成为一人房屋翻新团队的独特机会。购买、整修、升级破损的房屋，赋予它们新的生命，并以更高的价格卖出！

House Flipper is a unique chance to become the one-man renovating crew. You've got to earn it around here before you purchase your first property. No worries though! Luckily, there's plenty of work at your fingertips! Take job offers from nearby residents to clean up, paint walls, install heaters, showers, and air conditioners, or even furnish their whole property! Once the grateful clients pay you for your solid work, it's time to get your own house.

在您购买第一处房产之前，您必须想办法获得一些启动资金。不过不用担心！ 幸运的是，有很多工作触手可及！接受附近居民的任务 —— 清洁房屋、粉刷墙壁、安装暖气片、淋浴和空调，甚至为他们的房屋布置家具！ 一旦客户为您的辛勤工作付了钱，你就可以购买属于自己的房子了。
 
      
 
 拿起你的锤子！粗鲁地推倒一些墙壁！清除碎玻璃碎片、垃圾和废弃家具，为彻底将房屋改头换面做好准备！你可以满足买家的每一个要求，你也可以将房屋布置成一个舒适的办公室来发展你的业务，怎么去做取决于你自己。
 
      
 
 幸运的是你并不孤单。 最值得信赖的工具就在这里！在您的油漆滚筒、窗户清洁剂、石膏工具、拖把、锤子，当然还有强大的平板电脑的帮助下，没有任何装修任务会吓到您！使用这些工具还可以为您提供经验，你将可以升级它们并磨练您的技能，使您的工作更加愉快。
 
      
 
 无论您是打算建造梦想中的房子、帮助居民进行翻修还是单纯地喜欢破坏东西，这些都无关紧要 ——《房产达人》将帮助您放松心情。 坐下来，忘掉日常烦恼，沉浸在《房产达人》的世界中吧！

購買你的第一項房產前，先需要賺到足夠的錢。不必擔心，幸好有不少的工作！接受來自鄰里的任務：清潔他們的房屋、將牆壁塗油漆、安裝暖氣、淋浴間或冷氣、甚至布置整個房產。滿意的客戶會向你提供不錯的報酬，而你會逐漸地接近買自己的房子的目標。
 
      
 
 拿起鎚子！是時候讓自己有點骯髒，並且拆掉幾張牆壁。處理碎玻璃、垃圾、剩下的家具部件，並且準備全面改造的空間。想要達到個別客戶的所有要求還是為自己做一間十分適合自營的，舒適的辦公室，由你決定。
 
      
 
 幸好，你並不孤單。油漆滾筒、玻璃刮水器、漆刀、拖把、鎚子與可靠的平板電腦......在最忠心耿耿夥伴：即工具的幫助下，任何任務都不可怕。使用它們讓你獲得經驗以便使你的工作更加愉快。
 
      
 
 不管你打算建設夢想裡的房屋，幫助居民翻新房子還是搗毀些甚麼，《房產達人》幫你放鬆。舒服地坐下，忘記日常的煩惱，並且埋頭《房產達人》世界！

You've got to earn it around here before you purchase your first property. 
 No worries though! Luckily, there's plenty of work at your fingertips! 
 Take job offers from nearby residents - clean up, paint walls, install heaters, showers, and air conditioners, or even furnish their whole property! 
 Once the grateful clients pay you for your solid work, it's time to get your own house.
 
 
      
 
 Grab your hammer! It's time to take a bit of a rude approach and knock some walls down! 
 Get rid of broken glass shards, litter, and leftover pieces of furniture, to prepare the place for a complete makeover! 
 It's up to you to either meet every single requirement of specific buyers or make yourself a cozy office to grow your business in.
 
      
 
 Fortunately, you're not alone. The set of your trustiest tools is here with ya! 
 With the help of your paint roller, window cleaner, plaster tool, mop, hammer, and of course, the mighty tablet, no renovation will scare you! 
 Using those tools also gives you experience, which can be used to upgrade them and polish your skills, making your work even more pleasant.
 
      
 
 Regardless if you plan to create the house of your dreams, help the residents with their renovations or feel the need to smack some walls - 
 House Flipper is here for You! So just sit comfortably, let go off your usual daily routine, and delve into the world of House Flipper... into your world!

Antes de poder adquirir tu primera propiedad, debes ganártela. 
 No te preocupes, ¡por suerte hay mucho que hacer! Acepta ofertas de trabajo de los residentes: 
 limpia sus casas, pinta las paredes, instala calefacción, duchas y aire acondicionado, e incluso amuebla propiedades enteras. 
 Si los clientes quedan satisfechos recompensarán bien tu trabajo y cada vez estarás más cerca de comprar tu propia casa.
 
      
 
 ¡Martillo en mano! Es hora de ensuciarse un poco y tirar algunas paredes. 
 Deshazte de los trozos de vidrio, la basura, los restos de muebles y prepara el espacio para una metamorfosis completa. 
 De ti depende si quieres cumplir todos los requisitos de los compradores o prefieres organizar una oficina acogedora, 
 perfecta para administrar tu propio negocio.
 
      
 
 Por suerte, no estás solo. Un rodillo de pintura, un limpiacristales, una espátula, una fregona, un martillo y una tableta... 
 Con ayuda de tus compañeros más fieles, las herramientas, ningún pedido será terrible. 
 Con ellas podrás ganar experiencia y desarrollar habilidades, lo que hará que tu trabajo sea aún más agradable.
 
      
 
 No importa si planeas crear la casa de tus sueños, ayudar a los residentes con sus reformas o romper algo, 
 House Flipper te ayudará a relajarte. 
 ¡Siéntate, olvídeate de las preocupaciones diarias y sumérjete en el mundo de House Flipper!

Vous devrez économiser un peu avant de pouvoir acheter votre première propriété. Mais pas d'inquiétudes ! 
 Vous avez accès à de nombreuses missions ! Acceptez les contrats de vos voisins - nettoyez, peignez, installez, et meublez leur propriété ! 
 Une fois que vos clients vous auront payé pour votre dur labeur, vous pourrez acheter votre propre maison.
 
      
 
 Prenez un marteau ! Il est temps de vous défouler et de détruire quelques murs ! 
 Débarrassez-vous des débris de verre, des détritus et des vieux meubles, et préparez l'endroit pour une rénovation complète ! 
 À vous de décider si vous voulez vous plier à toutes les exigences des acheteurs, 
 ou si vous voulez vous concevoir un bureau confortable pour vous développer encore plus.
 
      
 
 Heureusement, vous n'êtes pas seul. Vous êtes accompagné d'un ensemble d'outils très fiables ! 
 Avec l'aide d'un rouleau de peinture, d'un lave-vitre, de plâtre, d'un balai, d'un marteau, 
 et bien sûr, d'une tablette, aucune rénovation ne vous fera reculer ! 
 Utiliser ces outils augmentera votre expérience, qui vous permettra de les améliorer, eux et vos compétences, rendant la tâche plus agréable.
 
      
 
 Que vous vouliez créer la maison de vos rêves, aider vos voisins à rénover leur maison, ou démolir quelques murs - House Flipper est là pour vous ! 
 Alors asseyez-vous confortablement, abandonnez votre routine habituelle, 
 et plongez dans le monde de House Flipper… dans votre monde !

Du musst dir hier zuerst einen Namen machen, bevor du deine erste Immobilie kaufen kannst. 
 Aber mach dir keine Sorgen, denn zum Glück gibt es hier mehr Arbeit als genug! 
 Nimm Jobangebote von Einwohnern in der Umgebung an - Reinigungen, Wände anstreichen, Heizungen, 
 Duschen und Klimaanlagen installieren oder sogar ganze Immobilien möblieren! 
 Sobald die dankbaren Kunden deine zuverlässige Arbeit bezahlt haben, kannst du dir ein eigenes Haus kaufen.
 
      
 
 Schnapp dir deinen Hammer, denn wir werden hart zuschlagen und ein paar Mauern zerstören! 
 Entsorge Glasscherben, Abfälle und Möbelreste, um die Immobilie auf eine Runderneuerung vorzubereiten! 
 Du musst dich entscheiden, ob du allen Bedingungen bestimmter Käufer nachkommen 
 oder dein eigenes gemütliches Büro bauen möchtest, damit dein Geschäft wachsen kann.
 
      
 
 Glücklicherweise bist du nicht alleine, denn du hast deine treuen Werkzeuge dabei! 
 Dank deiner Farbroller, Fensterputzer, Putzwerkzeuge, Wischer, Hammer - und natürlich - 
 dem mächtigen Tablet, bist du jeder Renovierung gewachsen! 
 Diese Werkzeuge bringen dir auch Erfahrungspunkte ein, damit du sie und deine Fähigkeiten verbessern kannst. 
 Dadurch wird deine Arbeit noch angenehmer.
 
      
 
 Egal ob du das Haus deiner Träume bauen, den Einwohnern bei ihren Renovierungen helfen 
 oder ein paar Wände zerstören möchtest - House Flipper ist immer für dich da! 
 Lehn dich also zurück, lass deine täglichen Routinen hinter dir und tauche in die Welt von House Flipper ein ... deiner Welt!

Para poder comprar o teu primeiro imóvel precisas ganhar um pouco de dinheiro. 
 Não te preocupes - felizmente, há muito trabalho para ti! Aceita as ofertas de emprego dos residentes da zona 
 - limpa as suas casas, pinta as paredes, faz a instalação de aquecimento, do sistema de duche ou de ar condicionado ou, 
 até mesmo, mobília casas inteiras. Os clientes satisfeitos pagaram bem pelo teu trabalho e tu, 
 com cada cheque de pagamento, estarás mais perto de comprar a tua própria casa.
 
      
 
 Apanha o martelo! Chegou a hora de te sujar e derrubar umas paredes. 
 Tira os pedaços de vidro, lixo, restos de móveis e prepara o espaço para uma metamorfose completa.
 
      
 
 Felizmente, não estás sozinho. O teu rolo de pintura, o limpa-vidros, a espátula, a esfregona, o martelo e o táblete que nunca falha... 
 Com a ajuda dos companheiros mais leais, ou seja, as tuas ferramentas, nenhum trabalho será difícil. 
 Ao usá-los ganharás experiência e melhorarás as habilidades e, assim, o teu trabalho vai tornar-se ainda mais agradável.
 
      
 
 Não importa se estás a pensar em criar a casa dos teus sonhos, ajudas os residentes a realizar renovações ou, 
 simplesmente, sentes vontade de arrebentar alguma coisa - 
 o House Flipper vai ajudar-te a relaxar. Senta-te, esqueça as tuas preocupações diárias e mergulha no mundo do House Flipper!

最初の財産を買う前に、あなたは必要なお金を稼がなければならない。
 心配しないで、儲けるチャンスは幾らでもある！例えば、地元住民からの仕事を受け入れる手がある：
 彼らの家を掃除したり、壁を塗ったり、暖房やシャワーやエアコンなど設置したりして、物件全体を整える事もあるだろう。
 満足された依頼人はあなたの働きに十分に報いるだろうから、あなたが段々自分の家を買うことに近づく。
 
      
 
 ハンマーを手に！壁数枚を壊しましょう。ガラスの破片とゴミ、家具のスクラップなどを取り除き、完全なリフォームに向けてスペースを準備する。
 個々の依頼人のすべての要件を満たしすか、あなた自身のビジネスを運営するのに最適な居心地の良いオフィスを手配したいのかはあなた次第だ。
 
      
 
 幸いなことに、あなたは一人ではない。ペイントローラーやウィンドウウォッシャー、パテナイフにモップとハンマー、そして頼もしいタブレット...　
 その全てがあなたの信用できる戦友であるツールだ。その助けがあれば、どんな注文でも問題なく完成できる。
 道具を使用すれば、経験を積み、スキルを磨くことができ、仕事が楽しくなる一方。
 
      
 
 夢の家を作ることを図っているのか、入居者をリフォームに助けたいのか、単に何かを壊したいのかは関係ない!
 『House Flipper』はあなたにリラックスさせるに違いない。
 腰を掛けて、毎日の悩みを忘れ、「House Flipper」の世界に没頭しよう！

You've got to earn it around here before you purchase your first property. 
 No worries though! Luckily, there's plenty of work at your fingertips! 
 Take job offers from nearby residents - clean up, paint walls, install heaters, showers, and air conditioners, or even furnish their whole property! 
 Once the grateful clients pay you for your solid work, it's time to get your own house.
 
 
      
 
 Grab your hammer! It's time to take a bit of a rude approach and knock some walls down! 
 Get rid of broken glass shards, litter, and leftover pieces of furniture, to prepare the place for a complete makeover! 
 It's up to you to either meet every single requirement of specific buyers or make yourself a cozy office to grow your business in.
 
      
 
 Fortunately, you're not alone. The set of your trustiest tools is here with ya! 
 With the help of your paint roller, window cleaner, plaster tool, mop, hammer, and of course, the mighty tablet, no renovation will scare you! 
 Using those tools also gives you experience, which can be used to upgrade them and polish your skills, making your work even more pleasant.
 
      
 
 Regardless if you plan to create the house of your dreams, help the residents with their renovations or feel the need to smack some walls - 
 House Flipper is here for You! So just sit comfortably, let go off your usual daily routine, and delve into the world of House Flipper... into your world!

game.description:
Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. 

Reclaim Your Ancestor's Estate 

Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes through twisted forests, forgotten warrens, ruined crypts, and beyond. You'll battle not only unimaginable foes, but stress, famine, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Uncover strange mysteries, and pit the heroes against an array of fearsome monsters with an innovative strategic turn-based combat system.
 
Core Features   

- The Affliction System – battle not only monsters, but stress! Contend with paranoia, masochism, fear, irrationality, and a host of gameplay-meaningful quirks!  
- Striking hand-drawn gothic crowquill art style  Innovative turn-based combat pits you against a host of diabolical monsters  
- Narration system to celebrate your successes...and failures  
- 16 (and counting!) playable hero classes, including Plague Doctor, Hellion, and even the Leper!
- Camp to heal wounds or deliver inspiring speeches.  
- Rest your weary, shell-shocked characters in town at the Tavern or the Abbey to keep their stress in check.
- Classic CRPG and roguelike features, including character permadeath, procedural dungeons, and incredible replay  
  
Can you stem the tide of eldritch horrors erupting across your family’s ancestral estate?
 
Descend at your peril! 

Awards and Honors 
   
- PG Gamer: Best RPG of 2016  
- Game Informer - Best RPGs of 2016: 3 Awards  
- IGN - Best of 2016: 2 Nominations  
- IGF 2016 - 3 Nominations  
- Rock Paper Shotgun - 50 Best RPGs of All Time  
- PAX 10 - 2015  
- Game Debate Best Indie Game 2016  
- SXSW Gamer's Choice Nominee 2015  
- MMORPG - Best Indie RPG (Pax East 2014), Best RPG Nomination PAX Prime 2014  
- Indie Megabooth Selection - PAX East 2014, PAX Prime 2015

Darkest Dungeon es un desafiante juego de rol gótico en mazmorras y por turnos que gira en torno al esfuerzo psicológico de la aventura.
 
Recluta, entrena y lidera a un equipo de héroes imperfectos a través de enrevesados bosques, laberintos olvidados, criptas en ruinas y más allá. Te enfrentarás no solo a enemigos inimaginables, sino al esfuerzo, el hambre, la enfermedad y la siempre acechante oscuridad. Descubre extraños misterios y enfrenta a los héroes a una serie de temibles monstruos con un innovador sistema de combate estratégico por turnos.
 
- 3 modos de juego y más de 80 horas de duración
- Compatibilidad con Steam Workshop para uso de modificaciones
- Sistema de aflicción: ¡enfréntate no solo a monstruos, sino al esfuerzo! ¡Lidia con la paranoia, el masoquismo, el miedo, la irracionalidad y una serie de peculiaridades que afectarán a la dinámica de juego!
- Impresionante estilo de ilustraciones góticas dibujadas a mano.
- El innovador combate por turnos te enfrenta a una horda de monstruos diabólicos.
- ¡16 clases de héroes seleccionables (¡y más que se añadirán!), entre ellos la doctora de plagas, la diabla e incluso un leproso!
- Acampa para curar heridas o dar discursos inspiradores.
- Permite que tus agotados personajes descansen en la ciudad, la taberna o la abadía para que el esfuerzo no les afecte.
- Características de los clásicos juegos de rol y mazmorras, como la muerte permanente, las mazmorras generadas por procedimientos e increíbles posibilidades de volver a jugar  
 
¿Puedes contener la horda de horrores y espíritus que están surgiendo en el feudo ancestral de tu familia?
 
¡Desciende bajo tu propio riesgo! 

Premios y menciones

Darkest Dungeon est un JdR rogue-like au tour par tour, gothique et sans pitié, sur le stress psychologique de partir à l'aventure.
  
Recrute, entraîne et mène une équipe d'anti-héros au travers de forêts déformées, de tanières oubliées, de cryptes en ruines et au-delà. Tu combattras non seulement des ennemis inimaginables mais aussi le stress, la famine, la maladie et les envahissantes ténèbres. Découvre d'étrange mystères et lance les héros contre un ensemble de monstres effrayants grâce à un système de combat au tour par tour innovant.
 
- 3 modes de jeu et plus de 80 heures d'amusement
- Intégration des mods dans Steam Workshop
- Le système d'affliction. Combats non seulement les monstres mais aussi le stress ! Gère la paranoïa, le masochisme, la peur, l’irrationalité et tout un éventail de manies influant sur le jeu !
- Style graphique gothique frappant réalisé à la main avec un effet plume de corbeau
- Des combats innovants au tour par tour vous font affronter une horde de monstres diaboliques
- 16 (à ce jour !) classes de héros jouables, dont le Docteur Lapeste, la Furie et même le Lépreux!
- Campe pour soigner tes blessures ou faire des discours exaltants.
- Envoie tes personnages épuisés et en état de choc en ville à la taverne ou à l'abbaye pour juguler leur stress.
- CRPG classique et fonctionnalités de rogue-like dont la mort permanente, les donjons générés procéduralement et une rejouabilité incroyable  
 
Pourras-tu tarir la vague d'horreurs sans nom qui surgissent dans ton domaine de famille ancestral ?
 
Descends à tes risques et périls !

Darkest Dungeon ist ein anspruchsvolles, rundenbasiertes Gothic-Rollenspiel mit Roguelike-Elementen, bei dem es um die psychologischen Belastungen bei Abenteuern geht.
 
Rekrutiere und trainiere eine Gruppe zusammengewürfelter Helden und führe sie durch düstere Wälder, vergessene Labyrinthe, Gruftruinen und mehr. Dabei musst du dich nicht nur unvorstellbaren Gegnern stellen, sondern dich auch mit Stress, Hunger, Seuchen und der allgegenwärtigen Dunkelheit auseinandersetzen. Entdecke rätselhafte Geheimnisse und lass deine Helden in einem innovativen, strategischen, rundenbasierten Kampfsystem gegen eine Vielfalt furchterregender Monster antreten.
 
- 3 Spielmodi und über 80 Stunden Spielzeit
- Steam-Workshop-Integrierung für Mods
- Das Qualensystem – Du kämpfst nicht nur gegen Monster, sondern gegen Stress, Paranoia, Masochismus, Angst, Wahn und viele andere Ticks, die sich auf das Spiel auswirken!
- Einzigartige, von Hand gezeichnete Grafiken im Federkielstil.
- Innovative, rundenbasierte Kämpfe gegen eine Vielzahl teuflischer Monster.
- 16 (Tendenz steigend!) spielbare Heldenklassen, darunter Seuchendoktorin, Barbarin und der Aussätzige!
- Lagere, um Wunden zu heilen oder motivierende Reden zu schwingen.
- Schicke deine erschöpften, kriegsneurotischen Charaktere in die Dorftaverne oder ins Kloster, damit sie sich von der Anspannung und den Strapazen erholen können.
- Klassische Funktionen von Computer-Rollenspielen und Roguelikes – darunter eine sinnvolle Permadeath-Funktion, prozedural generierte Dungeons und ein unglaublich hoher Wiederspielwert.  

Kannst du dem Ansturm der grauenhafter Scheusale standhalten, die auf dem Stammsitz deiner Vorfahren ihr Unwesen treiben?

Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes against unimaginable horrors, stress, famine, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Can you keep your heroes together when all hope is lost?

game.brief:
Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring. 

Reclaim Your Ancestor's Estate 

Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes through twisted forests, forgotten warrens, ruined crypts, and beyond. You'll battle not only unimaginable foes, but stress, famine, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Uncover strange mysteries, and pit the heroes against an array of fearsome monsters with an innovative strategic turn-based combat system.
 
Core Features   

- The Affliction System – battle not only monsters, but stress! Contend with paranoia, masochism, fear, irrationality, and a host of gameplay-meaningful quirks!  
- Striking hand-drawn gothic crowquill art style  Innovative turn-based combat pits you against a host of diabolical monsters  
- Narration system to celebrate your successes...and failures  
- 16 (and counting!) playable hero classes, including Plague Doctor, Hellion, and even the Leper!
- Camp to heal wounds or deliver inspiring speeches.  
- Rest your weary, shell-shocked characters in town at the Tavern or the Abbey to keep their stress in check.
- Classic CRPG and roguelike features, including character permadeath, procedural dungeons, and incredible replay  
  
Can you stem the tide of eldritch horrors erupting across your family’s ancestral estate?
 
Descend at your peril!

game.title: Super Mario Sunshine
game.description:
Super Mario Sunshine is a Mario action-adventure 3D platformer. It follows Super Mario 64, and is the second 3D Mario platformer. Gameplay features a combination of action and puzzle solving, with numerous stages and multiple episodes to each stage, and plenty of hidden secrets and surprises. This game introduced many recurring characters and bosses in the Mario series, including Toadsworth, Bowser Jr., Petey Piranha, Gooper Blooper, Piantas, Nokis, Shadow Mario, and F.L.U.D.D. Super Mario Sunshine pays homage to Mario's Italian heritage and upbringing, with many of the locations in the game having Italian names and sometimes referencing Italian culture.

Close your eyes and imagine…soothing sunshine accompanied by the sound of waves gently breaking on the shore. High above, seagulls turn lazy circles in a clear blue sky. This is Isle Delfino.

Far from the hustle and bustle of the Mushroom Kingdom, this island resort glitters like a gem in the waters of a southern sea.

Mario, Peach, and an entourage of Toads have come to Isle Delfino to relax and unwind. At least, that’s their plan…but when they arrive, they find things have gone horribly wrong...

According to the island inhabitants, the person responsible for the mess has a round nose, a thick mustache, and a cap…

What? But…that sounds like Mario!!

The islanders are saying that Mario's mess has polluted the island and caused their energy source, the Shine Sprites, to vanish.

Now the falsely accused Mario has promised to clean up the island, but...how?

Never fear! FLUDD, the latest invention from Gadd Science, Inc., can help Mario tidy up the island, take on baddies, and lend a nozzle in all kinds of sticky situations.

Can Mario clean the island, capture the villain, and clear his good name? It’s time for another Mario adventure to get started!

game.title: The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening
game.description:
The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening is a remake of the 1993 game of the same name. Besides the complete graphical and sound overhaul, its gameplay controls have been changed to incorporate the additional buttons the Switch holds as opposed to the 2-button choice of the Game Boy. The overworld map is far more detailed and specific locations can now be marked to be returned to on a later occasion. Additional heart-pieces can also be won, extending the heart meter to a total of 20 instead of the 14 hearts of the original.

After the events of A Link to the Past, the hero Link travels by ship to other countries to train for further threats. After being attacked at sea, Link's ship sinks and he finds himself stranded on Koholint Island. He awakens to see a beautiful woman looking down at him and soon learns the island has a giant egg on top of a mountain that the Wind Fish inhabits deep inside. Link is told to awaken the wind fish and all will be answered, so he sets out on another quest.

game.title: Chivalry 2
game.description:
Return to the ultimate medieval battlefield!   
 
 Chivalry 2 is a multiplayer first person slasher inspired by epic medieval movie battles. Players are thrust into the action of every iconic moment of the era — from clashing swords, to storms of flaming arrows, to sprawling castle sieges and more.
 
 Dominate massive, 64-player battlefields. Catapults tear the earth apart as you lay siege to castles, set fire to villages and slaughter filthy peasants in the return of Team Objective maps. 
 
 A fully featured mounted combat system makes you feel like you are fighting atop a thousand pound beast of war, including the ability to trample your foes, land devastating front or rear horse kicks, unhorse your opponent with a lance and engage in deep melee combat with grounded or mounted opponents.
  
 Rise to glory and expand your arsenal with a new subclass system that provides more variety than ever before. Four base classes expand to 10+ subclasses and over 30 unique weapons, each with multiple visual variants. New support items ranging from oil pots to barricades, supply crates and archer’s stakes add even more tactical options to the battlefield.
 
 Charge to battle alongside your friends with all-platform Crossplay and claim glory by your blade!

localized_description.text: 回到终极中世纪战场 《Chivalry 2》是一款灵感源于中世纪战争史诗电影的多人第一人称砍杀游戏，玩家们将体验到这个时代的所有标志性时刻——从剑刃交锋，到燃烧箭雨，再到铺天盖地的城堡围攻等等，应有尽有。

Return to the ultimate medieval battlefield!   
 
 Chivalry 2 is a multiplayer first person slasher inspired by epic medieval movie battles. Players are thrust into the action of every iconic moment of the era — from clashing swords, to storms of flaming arrows, to sprawling castle sieges and more.
 
 Dominate massive, 64-player battlefields. Catapults tear the earth apart as you lay siege to castles, set fire to villages and slaughter filthy peasants in the return of Team Objective maps. 
 
 A fully featured mounted combat system makes you feel like you are fighting atop a thousand pound beast of war, including the ability to trample your foes, land devastating front or rear horse kicks, unhorse your opponent with a lance and engage in deep melee combat with grounded or mounted opponents.

New support items ranging from oil pots to barricades, supply crates and archer’s stakes add even more tactical options to the battlefield.
 
 Charge to battle alongside your friends with all-platform Crossplay and claim glory by your blade!

Vuelve al campo de batalla medieval definitivo. 

 Chivalry 2 es un juego multijugador de batallas en primera persona inspiradas en las películas de estilo medieval. Los jugadores se lanzan a la batalla en situaciones icónicas de esta época: enfrentamientos a golpe de espada, tormentas de flechas flamígeras, enormes asedios a castillos, y mucho más. 
 
 ¡Entra al combate desde cualquier plataforma con el juego cruzado!

• Pelea en batallas cinemáticas impresionantes de 64 jugadores inspiradas en películas de acción medievales
• Vive conflictos a gran escala en enormes entornos medievales, desde zonas de torneo hasta asedios a un castillo a escala real
• Elige tu estilo de juego con 4 clases y 12 subclases, cada una con armas y habilidades únicas 
 ¡y mucho más!

Retour sur l'ultime champ de bataille médiéval. 

 Chivalry 2 est un jeu d'action multijoueur en vue à la première personne inspiré des combats épiques médiévaux. Les joueurs se plongeront dans l'action de chaque situation emblématique de l'époque : un affrontement à l'épée, une tempête de flèches enflammées, un siège de château sans fin, et bien d'autres encore. 
 
 Battez-vous grâce au cross-play sur toutes les plateformes !
 
• Plongez au cœur de batailles grandioses à 64 joueurs inspirées des films d'action épiques médiévaux
 
• Participez à conflits à grande échelle dans d'immenses décors médiévaux allant des terrains de tournoi aux sièges de château grandeur nature

 • Choisissez votre style de jeu parmi les 4 classes et 12 sous-classes disponibles, chacune offrant ses propres armes et capacités 

 et bien plus !

Kehre auf das ultimative mittelalterliche Schlachtfeld zurück. 

 Chivalry 2 ist ein Mehrspieler-Slasher in der Egoperspektive, inspiriert von epischen Schlachten aus Mittelalterfilmen. Spieler erleben all die legendären Momente dieser Ära – von klirrenden Schwertern bis hin zu flammenden Pfeilhageln, großen Burgbelagerungen und mehr. 
 
 ●	Stürze dich dank Crossplay auf allen Plattformen in die Schlacht!
 ●	Stürme in beeindruckende Schlachten mit 64 Spielern, inspiriert von epischen Mittelalter-Action-Filmen
 ●	Erlebe großflächige Konflikte vor mittelalterlichen Kulissen, von Turniergeländen bis hin zu riesigen Burgbelagerungen
 ●	Wähle deinen Spielstil aus 4 Klassen und 12 Unterklassen, jede mit einzigartigen Waffen und Fertigkeiten 
 ●	und viel mehr!

Regressa ao derradeiro campo de batalha medieval! 
 
 Chivalry 2 é um jogo de combate multijogador na primeira pessoa, inspirado por batalhas medievais cinematográficas épicas. Desde lutas de espadas a ataques de flechas flamejantes, passando por enormes cercos a castelos, vais participar em todos os momentos icónicos do combate medieval.
 
 Domina campos de batalha gigantescos para 64 jogadores. As catapultas rasgam a terra enquanto cercas castelos, incendeias aldeias e chacinas camponeses no regresso dos mapas Objetivo de Equipa. 

 Um sistema completo de combate montado vai fazer com que te sintas a lutar em cima de uma besta de guerra de quatrocentos quilos, com a capacidade de espezinhar os inimigos, dar coices frontais ou traseiros devastadores, desmontar os adversários com uma lança e participar em combates corpo a corpo com oponentes apeados ou montados. 
 
 Luta pela glória e expande o teu arsenal com um novo sistema de subclasses que proporciona mais variedade do que nunca. As quatro classes básicas expandem-se a mais de 10 subclasses e mais de 30 armas exclusivas, cada uma com variantes visuais. Os novos objetos de apoio, que vão de potes de óleo a barricadas, caixas de mantimentos e estacas para arqueiros, acrescentam ainda mais opções táticas ao campo de batalha.
 
 Vai à carga em batalhas multiplataforma com amigos, compatível com todas as plataformas, e conquista a vitória pela lei da tua espada!

Vend tilbage til den ultimative middelalderslagmark!   
 
 Chivalry 2 er et førstepersonskampspil, som er inspireret af de episke middelalderslag fra filmens verden. Spillerne kastes ind i kampens hede i hvert skelsættende moment i tidsalderen – fra sværdslag til ildpile og belejringer af store slotte med mere.  
 
 Kast dig ud i fantastiske 64-spillers slag. Katapulter smadrer igennem alt og alle, når du belejrer fæstninger, sætter ild til landsbyer og nedslagter usle bønder på Team Objective-kort.   
 
 Et fuldt udviklet rytterkampsystem får dig til at føle, at du sidder overskrævs på et 500 kilo tungt kampbæst, som kan nedtrampe dine fjender og levere dødbringende spark med for- og bagben. Du kan også vælte dine fjenderne af hesten med en lanse og kaste dig ud i dødelig nærkamp med fjender på jorden eller på hesteryg.  
 
 Kæmp dig til hæder og ære, og udvid dit arsenal med nye undersystemer, som giver dig mere variation end nogensinde før. Fire grundklasser udvider sig til 10+ underklasser og over 30 unikke våben som alle har flere visuelle varianter. Nye støttegenstande omfatter alt fra oliekrukker til barrikader, forsyningskasser og tilspidsede pæle, og de giver dig endnu flere taktiske muligheder på slagmarken.
 
 Gå i kamp med dine venner på tværs af alle platforme, og kæmp dig til sejren med dit sværd!

Ritorna sul campo di battaglia medievale definitivo. 

 Chivalry 2 è uno slasher multigiocatore in prima persona ispirato alle battaglie medievali cinematografiche. I giocatori potranno vivere i momenti più iconici di quest'era, dagli scontri con le spade alle piogge di frecce infuocate, passando per gli assedi dei castelli e tanto altro ancora. 
 
 Scendi sul campo di battaglia grazie al cross-play tra tutte le piattaforme!
 
• Buttati a capofitto in battaglie mozzafiato da 64 giocatori ispirate ad epici film d'azione medievali
 
• Vivi l'esperienza di conflitti su larga scala ambientati nel medioevo, con tornei e assedi dei castelli
 
• Scegli il tuo stile di gioco tra 4 classi e 12 sottoclassi diverse, ognuna con le sue armi e abilità uniche 

 e tanto altro!

game.brief:
Return to the ultimate medieval battlefield!   
 
 Chivalry 2 is a multiplayer first person slasher inspired by epic medieval movie battles. Players are thrust into the action of every iconic moment of the era — from clashing swords, to storms of flaming arrows, to sprawling castle sieges and more.
 
 Dominate massive, 64-player battlefields. Catapults tear the earth apart as you lay siege to castles, set fire to villages and slaughter filthy peasants in the return of Team Objective maps. 
 
 A fully featured mounted combat system makes you feel like you are fighting atop a thousand pound beast of war, including the ability to trample your foes, land devastating front or rear horse kicks, unhorse your opponent with a lance and engage in deep melee combat with grounded or mounted opponents.
  
 Rise to glory and expand your arsenal with a new subclass system that provides more variety than ever before. Four base classes expand to 10+ subclasses and over 30 unique weapons, each with multiple visual variants. New support items ranging from oil pots to barricades, supply crates and archer’s stakes add even more tactical options to the battlefield.
 
 Charge to battle alongside your friends with all-platform Crossplay and claim glory by your blade!

game.title: Planet of Lana
game.description:
A young girl and her loyal friend embark on a rescue mission through a colorful world full of cold machines and unfamiliar creatures. Planet of Lana is a cinematic puzzle adventure framed by an epic sci-fi saga that stretches across centuries and galaxies.

A planet that used to be a place of undisturbed balance between human, nature, and animal has now become something else entirely.

The disharmony that had been in the making for hundreds of years has finally arrived in the form of a faceless army. But this is not a story about war. This is a story about a vibrant, beautiful planet –and the journey to keep it that way.

Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf - OUT NOW!  Planet of Lana II follows Lana and Mui as they step into a new chapter in a changing world.
 On their home planet, new technology brings progress but also stirs greed and conflict. As harmony begins to shift, Lana and Mui are drawn into a journey to uncover long-buried truths about their world and themselves.

 Visit the Planet of Lana II Steam page to learn more.
 
  About the Game         
 
  A planet that used to be a place of undisturbed balance between human, nature, and animal has now become something else entirely.  
 
  The disharmony that had been in the making for hundreds of years has finally arrived in the form of a faceless army. But this is not a story about war. This is a story about a vibrant, beautiful planet –and the journey to keep it that way. 
 
   Key Features   
   Unique companion-based gameplay. 
   Solve puzzles with diverse challenges and quirky twists. 
   Carefully navigate dangerous situations using stealth and wit.
   Use your reflexes and survive challenging action sequences. 
   Discover an epic story that stretches across galaxies and centuries.

¡Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf llega el 5 de marzo de 2026!   Disfruta de un nuevo capítulo de las aventuras de Lana y Mui en un mundo cambiante en Planet of Lana II. 
 La nueva tecnología hace que su planeta natral progrese, pero también genera avaricia y conflictos. Cuando la armonía comienza a peligrar, Lana y Mui emprenden un viaje que revelará secretos ocultos desde hace mucho tiempo sobre su pasado y el del planeta. 
  
 Este viaje es una aventura cinemática mayor y más profunda que combina los elementos favoritos de los jugadores de Planet of Lana. 
  
 Visita la página de Steam de Planet of Lana II para obtener más información y añadir el juego a la lista de deseados.
 
  Acerca del juego        
 
 Un planeta que antaño fue un lugar donde los humanos y la naturaleza convivían en armonía se ha convertido en algo completamente distinto. 
 
 La discordia que lleva siglos gestándose finalmente ha hecho acto de presencia en forma de un ejército sin rostro. Pero esta no es una historia sobre guerra; esta es la historia de un viaje para proteger de un planeta hermoso y lleno de vida.

Planet of Lana II: Children of the Leaf - Sortie prévue le 5 mars 2026   Planet of Lana II accompagne Lana et Mui alors qu'elles entament un nouveau chapitre dans un monde en plein changement. 
 Sur leur planète natale, les nouvelles technologies sont synonymes de progrès, mais elles alimentent également la cupidité et les conflits. Tandis que l'harmonie commence à se dégrader, Lana et Mui se lancent dans un voyage pour dévoiler la vérité longtemps cachée sur leur monde et sur elles-mêmes. 
  
 Leur périple se transforme en une aventure cinématographique plus grandiose et plus profonde, tout en reprenant ce qui a séduit les joueurs de Planet of Lana. 
  
 Visite la page Steam de Planet of Lana II pour en savoir plus et ajouter le jeu à ta liste de souhaits.

 Une planète qui était autrefois un endroit d'équilibre tranquille entre humains, nature et animaux est désormais tout à fait autre chose. 
 
 La discorde qui se préparait depuis des centaines d'années est enfin arrivée sous la forme d'une armée sans visage. Mais ceci n'est pas l'histoire d'une guerre. C'est l'histoire d'une planète vivante et belle, et d'un voyage pour la préserver.

 Ihre Reise entwickelt sich in ein größeres Abenteuer im Kinoformat, das auf alles aufbaut, was Spieler und Spielerinnen an Planet of Lana geliebt haben.

 Ein Planet, der einst ein Ort des ungestörten Gleichgewichts zwischen Mensch, Natur und Tier war und inzwischen eine ganz andere Gestalt angenommen hat. 
 
 Die sich seit Jahrhunderten anbahnende Disharmonie hat sich am Ende in Form einer gesichtslosen Armee manifestiert. Aber dies ist keine Geschichte über Krieg. Sie handelt vielmehr von einem lebendigen, wunderschönen Planeten und dem Weg zu seiner Bewahrung.

game.title: Spyro Reignited Trilogy
game.description: Spyro Reignited Trilogy is a collection of remasters of the first three games in the Spyro series: Spyro the Dragon (1998), Ripto's Rage! (1999), and Year of the Dragon (2000).

localized_title.text: 小龙斯派罗：重燃三部曲

localized_description.text: Spyro Reignited Trilogy is a collection of remasters of the first three games in the Spyro series: Spyro the Dragon (1998), Ripto's Rage! (1999), and Year of the Dragon (2000).

¡El maestro de los asados está de vuelta! Las mismas llamas y la misma actitud abrasadora, pero mejorado y en alta definición. Spyro viene a toda mecha como nunca antes en la colección Spyro Reignited Trilogy. Reaviva la llama con los tres juegos originales: Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2 Ripto's Rage! y Spyro Year of the Dragon. Explora los amplios reinos, vuelve a encontrarte con sus arrolladores personajes y revive la aventura con todo el esplendor de una remasterización. Porque, cuando hay un reino que necesita ayuda, solo hay un dragón al que se puede recurrir.

Le véritable maître des flammes est de retour ! Toujours aussi brûlant et attachant, Spyro revient dans une HD flamboyante avec Spyro Reignited Trilogy ! Rallumez la flamme avec les trois jeux originaux,   Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! et Spyro: Year of the Dragon, tous intégralement remasterisés. Explorez les niveaux gigantesques, retrouvez des personnages inoubliables et revivez toutes ces aventures remasterisées en haute définition. Quand il y a un royaume à sauver, il n'y a qu'un seul dragon à appeler à la rescousse.

Der Meister der Flammen ist zurück! Wie immer ist er Feuer und Flamme, und jetzt brennt er auf neue Abenteuer in atemberaubendem HD. In der Spielesammlung Spyro Reignited Trilogy heizt Spyro seinen Gegnern ein wie nie zuvor. Lass die Spannung der drei Originalspiele Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! und Spyro: Year of the Dragon wieder aufflammen. Erkunde riesige Reiche und triff die hitzigen Persönlichkeiten des Abenteuers in vollständig neu gemasterter Pracht wieder. Denn es gibt nur einen Drachen, der gerufen wird, wann immer ein Reich in Gefahr ist.

O dragão original está de volta! A mesma cabeça quente, a mesma atitude escaldante e agora melhor que nunca em espantoso HD. O Spyro vai aquecer ainda mais as coisas na coleção de jogos Spyro Reignited Trilogy. Reacende as chamas com os três jogos originais: Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! e Spyro: Year of the Dragon. Explora os reinos expansivos, reencontra as personagens fogosas e recorda as aventuras num glorioso formato remasterizado. Porque quando há algum reino que necessite de ser salvo, só existe um dragão que podes chamar.

Den originale flammekaster er tilbage! Samme gnist, samme rygende temperament, men nu med endnu større flammer i storslået HD. Spyro skruer op for varmen som aldrig før i Spyro Reignited Trilogy! Genopvæk flammen med de originale tre spil Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! og Spyro: Year of the Dragon. med fantastisk remastered grafik. Udforske de enorme verdener, få et gensyn med de letantændelige personligheder, og oplev eventyret med fantastisk remastered grafik. Når riget er i fare, er der kun én drage, der kan klare skærene.

La situazione si fa... scottante! Vulcanico come sempre, irriverente più che mai e incredibilmente spettacolare in alta definizione, Spyro è tornato ed è pronto a scaldare gli animi con la collezione di giochi Spyro Reignited Trilogy. Dai fuoco alle polveri e goditi i tre titoli originali Spyro the Dragon, Spyro 2: Ripto's Rage! e Spyro: Year of the Dragon. Esplora regni sconfinati, ritrova personaggi indimenticabili, vivi un'avventura rimasterizzata in modo straordinario e ricorda: se il regno è in pericolo, c'è solo un drago che può salvarlo.

game.title: Payday 2
game.description: Payday 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original crew: Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains as they descend on Washington D.C. for an epic crime spree.

localized_description.text: Payday 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original crew: Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains as they descend on Washington D.C. for an epic crime spree.

PAYDAY 2是一款动作类四人合作射击游戏，各位玩家将再次扮演初代PAYDAY帮成员——达拉斯、霍斯顿、沃尔夫以及钱恩斯——并前往华盛顿特区展开一系列惊险刺激的劫案。
 
 CRIMENET网络提供了大量动态合约，玩家们可以自由选择打劫小型便利店或绑架人质，又或是执行大规模的网络犯罪或洗劫大型银行金库，掠取巨额收益。另外既然身处首都，何不在当地打好关系，顺便参与一些政治事务呢？
 
 每场劫案共有四名玩家可同时进行，并且随着玩家自身的不断成长，劫案难度与奖励也会不断提升。除了赚取一笔大钱成为传奇罪犯之外，还有目不暇接的角色自定义与制作系统，包括各项人物成长以及枪械和装备改造等着你来探索。 游戏亮点   抢银行，赚大钱 - 玩家需要仔细选择全队搭配，一旦劫案中情况有变，便需要各自本事与良好协作来迎接挑战。
   CRIMENET - 动态合约库使各位玩家可以联系各位合约人挑选心仪的劫案，这几位合约人包括乌克兰人弗拉德、油滑的政客“大象”、南美毒贩赫克特等等，他们各有自己的组织，并且经手的生意范畴也有所区别。
   全新升级的PAYDAY枪战机制 - 武器开火与捆绑人质的体验是你从未有过的全新感受。
   动态场景变化 - 一千位玩家能玩出一千种不同的劫案。每次场景中都有着些许变化或是稀有事件出现。
   选择你的技能 - 玩家在游戏过程中可以从以下五条技能树中累积能力：黑手、暴徒、技师、幽灵与逃犯。每条技能树均有着独特的定制化技能与装备获取，通过有效搭配便能使玩家成长为终极劫匪。
   面具数量再创新高 - PAYDAY 2加入了全新的面具系统，玩家现在可以选用自己喜爱的花纹与配色制作专属于自己的独特面具，从而创造出千变万化的不同组合。
   武器与改装 - 劫匪们将拥有自己的庞大军火库，从着重于远距离的狙击步枪与突击步枪到强调近身作战的手枪与冲锋枪等等。在你选定自己心仪的武器后，你还可以为其添加一系列包括瞄镜、消音器、前握把、准星、枪管、枪身以及枪托在内等方面俱到的模组改装，使你的武器达到最佳性能。此外还有完全基于审美意义上的改进内容——给你的爱枪换上胡桃木握把，让自己变成刀尖舔血的大毒枭范儿吧！
   游戏方式由你选择 - 每场劫案都有多种方式完成。你可以选择神不知鬼不觉地潜入目标地点完成任务，或是抄起家伙正面发动攻势。每种选择都会给你带来截然不同的体验。
   海量额外内容 - 自从游戏发布后已有70余项更新，其中包括新劫案、角色、武器以及其他游戏特性例如驾驶汽车和叉车等等。

PAYDAY 2 is an action-packed, four-player co-op shooter that once again lets gamers don the masks of the original PAYDAY crew - Dallas, Hoxton, Wolf and Chains - as they descend on Washington DC for an epic crime spree. 
 
 The CRIMENET network offers a huge range of dynamic contracts, and players are free to choose anything from small-time convenience store hits or kidnappings, to big league cyber-crime or emptying out major bank vaults for that epic PAYDAY. While in DC, why not participate in the local community, and run a few political errands?
 
 Up to four friends co-operate on the hits, and as the crew progresses the jobs become bigger, better and more rewarding. Along with earning more money and becoming a legendary criminal comes a character customization and crafting system that lets crews build and customize their own guns and gear. Key Features   Rob Banks, Get Paid – Players must choose their crew carefully, because when the job goes down they will need the right mix of skills on their side.
   CRIMENET – The dynamic contract database lets gamers pick and choose from available jobs by connecting with local contacts such as Vlad the Ukrainian, shady politician "The Elephant", and South American drug trafficker Hector, all with their own agenda and best interests in mind.
   PAYDAY Gunplay and Mechanics on a New Level – Firing weapons and zip tying civilians never felt so good.
   Dynamic Scenarios – No heist ever plays out the same way twice. Every single scenario has random geometry or even rare events.
   Choose Your Skills – As players progress they can invest in any of five special Skill Trees: Mastermind, Enforcer, Ghost, Technician and Fugitive. Each features a deep customization tree of associated skills and equipment to master, and they can be mixed and matched to create the ultimate heister.
   More Masks than Ever – PAYDAY 2 features a completely new mask system, giving players the ability to craft their own unique mask with a pattern and color of their choice, resulting in millions of different combinations.  
   Weapons and Modifications – A brand new arsenal for the serious heister, covering everything from sniper and assault rifles to compact PDWs and SMGs. Once you've settled for a favorite, you can modify it with optics, suppressors, fore grips, reticles, barrels, frames, stocks and more, all of which will affect the performance of your weapon. There are also purely aesthetic enhancements - why not go for the drug lord look with polished walnut grips for your nine?
   Play It Your Way – Each job allows for multiple approaches, such as slow and stealthy ambushes or running in guns blazing. Hit the target any way you want, each approach will provide a different experience.
   A Long History of Additional Content – More than 70 updates since release, including new heists, characters, weapons and other gameplay features like driving cars and forklifts.
